content.short: AllDomains Bridge enables cross-chain transfers of assets and data between leading Web3 blockchain ecosystems.
content.description: AllDomains Bridge tackles fragmentation across blockchain ecosystems by enabling fast, low-cost transfers of assets and data between Solana, Eclipse (SVM), Ethereum (EVM) and Sonic (SVM). It removes the complexity of long wallet addresses, letting users send crypto with human-readable domain names such as .turbo and .solana. This approach helps reduce input errors and makes cross-chain transactions more approachable for both newcomers and experienced users, simplifying how value and information move across networks.
content.meta: AllDomains Bridge provides cross-chain asset and data transfers. Discover AllDomains Bridge and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
